stem: Why does Jenny start drawing in her notebook when Mrs. Pike says that she has news for the class?

options.label: A
options.text: Jenny thinks the discussion will not be interesting.

options.label: B
options.text: Jenny is too busy thinking about the contest to listen.

options.label: C
options.text: Jenny is too upset with her best friend Beth to listen.

options.label: D
options.text: Jenny does not like being told what to do.
